{"sql":"SELECT
  signup_month::DATE AS signup_month,
  COUNT(*) AS signups,
  AVG(CASE WHEN is_email_verified THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS email_verified_rate,
  AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_started THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS kyc_started_rate,
  AVG(CASE WHEN is_doc_submitted THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS doc_submitted_rate,
  AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS kyc_approved_rate,
  AVG(CASE WHEN has_topup THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS first_topup_rate,
  AVG(CASE WHEN is_activated THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS activation_rate
FROM dim_users
WHERE channel = 'organic'
  AND signup_month >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
  AND signup_month < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'
GROUP BY signup_month
ORDER BY signup_month","rationale":"Returns organic signup counts and conversion rates at each onboarding stage by month, allowing the March–April 2026 activation change to be compared with historical variation and localized to a funnel stage."}
